title: EEG + Genetic Marker Fusion for Epileptic Seizure Prediction
summary: A multimodal seizure-prediction system that fuses EEG signal embeddings from a BiLSTM with genetic biomarker risk scores via attention-gated late fusion to predict epileptic seizures. SDV's CTGANSynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) is run in generate_ctgan_data.py to produce a synthetic patient cohort used strictly as a validation benchmark, not for training.
